prompt: install Rokit and set up the toolchain for this new Roblox repo
texts: You want Rokit installed and the toolchain (Rojo, StyLua, Selene and similar) set up for this new Roblox repo. I'll load the project-structure skill first, since it covers Rokit setup.

I couldn't install Rokit. The only shell tool available here, Bash, is disabled in this session, and I have no other way to run commands. Nothing on your machine has changed.

The repo already has its toolchain pinned in `rokit.toml`:

| Tool | Version |
| --- | --- |
| rojo | 7.7.1 |
| wally | 0.3.2 |
| stylua | 2.3.1 |
| selene | 0.29.0 |
| luau-lsp | 1.58.0 |

`scripts/check.sh` already runs `rokit install`, `wally install`, `stylua --check`, `selene` and `rojo build`. So after Rokit is installed, restoring the toolchain is one command.

To finish it, run this in PowerShell from the repo folder:

```powershell
# 1. Install Rokit (check the current command at https://github.com/rojo-rbx/rokit before running)
# 2. Open a new terminal so Rokit is on PATH, then:
rokit --version
rokit trust rojo-rbx/rojo UpliftGames/wally JohnnyMorganz/StyLua Kampfkarren/selene JohnnyMorganz/luau-lsp
rokit install
rojo --version
```

Tools in `rokit.toml` can trigger a trust prompt on first install, which is why I included the `trust` line. If you'd like me to run these myself, enable a shell tool and tell me. I'll then confirm that `rojo --version`, `stylua` and the other tools resolve to the pinned versions through Rokit, not through some other global install.

The repo has both `wally.toml` and `pesde.toml`. The tooling guidance says not to use both package managers on the same packages. `scripts/check.sh` only runs Wally. Which one do you want to keep? I'd suggest Wally, since the check script already uses it.
